## Pull request overview

This PR removes all embedded Sail functional descriptions (`sail(): |` blocks) from the instruction specs and eliminates all schema/tooling/template support and licensing that existed solely to carry those Sail snippets.

**Changes:**
- Stripped `sail(): |` blocks (and associated SPDX snippet markers) from instruction YAMLs/layouts, leaving IDL-only `operation()` content where present.
- Removed `"sail()"` from the instruction JSON schema and bumped schema `$id` from `v0.1` to `v0.2`.
- Updated documentation/templates/tooling to stop referencing or rendering Sail content, and removed the BSD-2-Clause license files that applied only to those snippets.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 300 out of 772 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

**LICENSE-BSD-2-Clause.txt:1**
